question: Give me a short summary of the annual leave policy.
expectedResponse: 20 days per year, accruing 1.67 days a month; request at least 5 working days ahead; up to 5 days carry over until 31 March; cancel up to 2 working days before; 11 public holidays do not count.
actualResponse:
- Full-time employees get 20 days of annual leave per year; part-time employees get a share in proportion to their contracted hours.
- Annual leave accrues at 1.67 days per month from the first day of employment.
- Leave must be submitted through the HR assistant or the HR portal at least 5 working days in advance; leave of more than 10 consecutive working days must be requested 4 weeks in advance.
- Up to 5 days of unused annual leave can be carried over to the next year and must be used before March 31; any excess is forfeited unless HR approves an exception in writing.
- Contoso has 11 public holidays each year, which do not count toward annual leave days.
explanation_1: All quality checks passed: The response is on topic, provides useful information, and is well supported by the available documents.
